canonical_definition: Lock product scope, actors and journeys: traveller, consumer app, courier app, retailer, policy author, independent reviewer, publisher, operator and auditor. Record excluded domains.

journeys.title: Browse jurisdiction and topic guidance
journeys.success: Read dated, sourced guidance with effective intervals and coverage limits
journeys.denied_or_failure: Missing or withdrawn coverage displays UNKNOWN; no legal-permission claim

journeys.title: Run an informational travel scenario
preconditions: No raw identity, address or live order inputs
journeys.success: Show reviewed explanation, obligations and unresolved issues
journeys.denied_or_failure: Unreviewed region/topic and incomplete facts show gaps; scenario cannot authorize an order

journeys.title: View Travel/Maps regional guidance and DOOBr presence
preconditions: Current policy visibility and independently supplied coarse availability
journeys.success: Show permitted public guidance and coarse presence with handoff to DOOBr
journeys.denied_or_failure: Stale supply/policy or anonymity failure suppresses presence; no identifiable courier or checkout

journeys.title: Evaluate an intended consumer operation
preconditions: Origin/destination, actor class and required evidence
journeys.success: Receive a short-lived action-bound decision and explicit obligations
journeys.denied_or_failure: Absent evidence, unsupported scope or non-ALLOW blocks the consuming operation

journeys.title: Reevaluate after policy or relevant fact change
preconditions: Changed facts, expiry or invalidation notice
journeys.success: Request fresh applicable evaluation without altering historical evidence
journeys.denied_or_failure: Cached approval, unavailable evaluator or policy conflict cannot preserve permission

journeys.title: Read a decision explanation
journeys.success: Read reason codes, evaluated versions and relevant obligations
journeys.denied_or_failure: Cross-tenant/subject request or replayed receipt denied; no public private-decision lookup

journeys.title: Evaluate pickup and dispatch
preconditions: Current order facts, region/time and stage
journeys.success: Return current decision and obligations for DOOBr to enforce
journeys.denied_or_failure: Wrong courier/actor class, revoked credential or stale policy prevents dispatch

journeys.title: Reevaluate at recipient handover
journeys.success: Return current decision; courier completes required human checks in DOOBr
journeys.denied_or_failure: Unknown recipient eligibility, failed evidence, policy change or outage blocks handover

journeys.title: Handle refusal and lawful return
journeys.success: Provide applicable return obligations; DOOBr manages custody and safe recovery
journeys.denied_or_failure: Sale denial never implies abandonment; no reuse of a delivery approval for return or new sale

journeys.title: Supply exact retailer credential references
preconditions: Independent approved credential source and exact store scope
journeys.success: Supply reference evidence used in a scoped decision
journeys.denied_or_failure: Self-declared listing, generic Identity validity or Verify badge cannot establish licence eligibility

journeys.title: Inspect tenant decision and record obligations
journeys.success: View explanation and redacted audit export; retailer retains its required order/delivery records
journeys.denied_or_failure: Cross-tenant export or public recipient/signature/address disclosure denied

journeys.title: Respond to credential or region revocation
preconditions: Current independent revocation or halt signal
journeys.success: Stop/reassess affected operations and reconcile evidence
journeys.denied_or_failure: Delayed notice or missed callback cannot keep stale authority; re-read current state

journeys.title: Prepare a source-linked policy proposal
preconditions: Pinned official evidence and proposed effective interval
journeys.success: Draft immutable review candidate with cited provisions and uncertainties
journeys.denied_or_failure: Unsupported source or AI proposal cannot become approved/active content

journeys.title: Submit a policy impact comparison
journeys.success: Explain new allow/deny/gap outcomes for affected apps/regions
journeys.denied_or_failure: Simulation cannot activate a policy; inconsistent citations or schema require rework

journeys.title: Independently review source and legal interpretation
preconditions: Qualified scope and unchanged candidate digest
journeys.success: Approve the reviewed digest or record bounded rejection/findings
journeys.denied_or_failure: Self-review, insufficient competence, unresolved mandatory conflict or changed bytes cannot approve

journeys.title: Request correction without rewriting history
journeys.success: Require a new candidate and fresh approval after correction
journeys.denied_or_failure: Approved content cannot be edited under an old signature; rejection is never activation

journeys.title: Schedule and publish approved content
preconditions: Publisher separate from author and reviewer
Current approval, signed manifest, environment and effective time
journeys.success: Publish exactly the approved digest to authorized region/domain at valid commencement
journeys.denied_or_failure: Wrong digest/environment, future commencement or revoked review prevents activation

journeys.title: Supersede or revoke a publication
journeys.success: Preserve history and trigger affected-consumer invalidation
journeys.denied_or_failure: Old decision/signature cannot reactivate revoked content; rollback cannot restore unlawful policy

journeys.title: Monitor source freshness and review backlog
journeys.success: Triage outage/expiry and route review; enforce required stale-state halt
journeys.denied_or_failure: Successful fetch alone does not renew legal review or approve a changed rule

journeys.title: Issue an emergency region/domain halt
preconditions: Incident reason, scope and audited command
journeys.success: Reduce permission and invalidate affected decisions while DOOBr recovers safely
journeys.denied_or_failure: Operator cannot replace DENY/UNKNOWN with ALLOW or invent emergency legal permission

journeys.title: Recover from outage or bad publication
preconditions: Currently valid approved policy and preserved revocation history
journeys.success: Restore service only using independently approved valid state
journeys.denied_or_failure: Old backup, revoked key or revoked policy cannot restore permission; uncertain state remains blocked

journeys.title: Inspect a bounded audit trail
preconditions: Tenant/domain evidence access and redaction policy
journeys.success: Inspect source, review, publication and decision chain of evidence
journeys.denied_or_failure: Audit role confers no write authority or unrestricted personal-data access

journeys.title: Reproduce a historical decision
preconditions: Lawful access to necessary minimized evidence
journeys.success: Reproduce assessed outcome with original versions and clearly historical timestamp
journeys.denied_or_failure: Missing/expired-retention evidence is a reproducibility gap, not a fabricated pass

journeys.title: Export independent review evidence
preconditions: Scoped export purpose and access grant
journeys.success: Export bounded reproducibility and review package with hashes
journeys.denied_or_failure: Export cannot expose private addresses, ID scans, signatures, precise tracking or unscoped decisions

excluded_domains.reason: Different legal/provider model; separate approved domain required
420Grow policy domain not covered by delivery/travel packs
420BnB venue/property and booking policy requires separate review
420Events permissions and consumption conditions are separate
General commerce/product-tax policies are separate from DOOBr delivery
No automatic national/provincial coverage; region pack qualification required
Domestic availability cannot authorize crossing national or provincial boundaries
Platform cannot issue or replace government licences
Monitoring and AI may propose changes but may not approve operative rules
No custody, escrow, payment, conversion, refund or fee-split authority
No public age/ID/address/signature/tracking/order evidence or reversible personal hashes
Responsive site/SDK sufficient initially; DOOBr owns native clients
No standalone fee, token or entitlement product in initial scope; DOOBr premium routing stays canonical
A reviewed bounded decision cannot certify every applicable law

open_questions_owned_by_later_steps.C01.3: Exact authority/source taxonomy, qualified reviewer ownership and legal questions
open_questions_owned_by_later_steps.C01.7: Service discovery and optional chain publication strategy
open_questions_owned_by_later_steps.C04: Reviewed policy packs and actual activation controls
open_questions_owned_by_later_steps.C09_C10: Real deployment, independent reviews, operating partners and live acceptance

scope_change_policy: Changes require explicit versioned product decision, affected-step qualification and preserved prior evidence; no silent expansion or permission inferred from a listing.
